# 🏨 OM Tours API (FastAPI Backend)

**REST API** powering the OM Tours travel platform with **auto-generated docs**, JWT auth, and CRUD operations.

[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-005571?logo=fastapi)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9+-3776AB?logo=python)](https://www.python.org)
[![Uvicorn](https://img.shields.io/badge/Uvicorn-5ccb93?logo=uvicorn)](https://www.uvicorn.org)

---

## 🚀 **5-Second Quickstart**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ABarpanda/March-Cohort.git
cd March-Cohort
uvicorn api.index:app --reload
```

#### 1. Swagger UI (Interactive)
🔗 **Access:** `http://localhost:8000/docs`  
✨ **Features:**
- **Try-it-out** functionality for all endpoints
- Automatic request/response schemas
- Direct API testing from browser
- JWT auth integration (if configured)

#### 2. ReDoc (Alternative)
🔗 **Access:** `http://localhost:8000/redoc`  
✨ **Features:**
- Clean, responsive documentation
- Collapsible sections
- Better for mobile viewing
- Printable format
